title: Music and singing
explanation: Sustained harmonic notes look like voiced speech to the mask, so instruments leak through while vocals are partly kept.

title: Long pauses with residual noise
explanation: With no speech for several seconds the floor of the mask drifts, and the remaining noise audibly pumps.

title: Very low SNR (−8 dB)
explanation: When noise dominates most bins, the model removes consonants together with the noise and the voice sounds muffled.

title: Competing talker
explanation: A second voice is speech too; the model was never trained to pick one talker, so it keeps both.
